## Assemblies
| Assembly | Source | References | Platforms |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Assembly-CSharp` (predefined) | all runtime code: `Assets/Scripts/`, `Assets/Inspection System/`, `Assets/Art*/`, `Assets/Tools/` (runtime parts), test-level scripts | packages (auto) | all |
| `Assembly-CSharp-Editor` (predefined) | every `Editor/` folder: `Assets/Editor/*.cs`, `Assets/Editor/PrefabPainter/`, `Assets/Tools/FolderTool/Editor/` | `Assembly-CSharp` | Editor |
| `Assembly-CSharp-firstpass` | `Assets/Plugins/` | — | all |
| `Project.Build.Editor` (`Assets/Editor/Build/Project.Build.Editor.asmdef`) | `BuildCommand`, `BuildArguments` | none, `autoReferenced: false` | Editor |
| `PrimeTween.Installer` | `Assets/Plugins/PrimeTween/internal/` | — | Editor |

No gameplay asmdefs and no test assemblies. Only `Tools.FolderTool.*` and `Project.Build.Editor` use namespaces.

## Editor tools
| Tool | Where | Entry |
|---|---|---|
| Prefab Painter (paint prefabs in SceneView, grid/chain snap, palette SO) | `Assets/Editor/PrefabPainter.cs` (window, UXML/USS) + `Assets/Editor/PrefabPainter/` | **Tools → Prefab Painter**; palette **Create → Tools → Prefab Painter → Palette**. `PrefabPainter/PrefabPainterWindow.cs` is a commented-out copy |
| Map Builder (grid-based module placement) | `Assets/Tools/MapCreator/MapBuilderTool.cs`, `MapBuilderPalette.cs` | **Tools → Map Builder** — see warning below |
| Object Replacer | `Assets/Editor/ObjectReplacerWindow.cs` | **Tools → Object Replacer** |
| Hierarchy Folder (visual folders, stripped at build by `FolderSceneProcessor`) | `Assets/Tools/FolderTool/` | **GameObject → Hierarchy Folder** |
| `LightMovement` inspector (curve preview) | `Assets/Editor/LightMovementEditor.cs` | custom inspector |
| `ShaderPropertyOverrides` (per-object shader overrides via MPB, `[ExecuteAlways]`) | `Assets/Scripts/Core/Utilities/ShaderPropertyOverrides.cs` + `Assets/Editor/ShaderPropertyOverridesEditor.cs` | custom inspector |
| Asset menus | `PlayerData`, `GlitchSounds`, `GlitchPalette`, `LaserData` (`[CreateAssetMenu]`), `InputDeviceDetector`, `InputPromptDatabase` (**Create → Systems → …**) | |

Known editor-code issues (not fixed by `/init-unity`):
- `MapBuilderTool.cs` guards the class with `#if UNITYEDITOR` (typo for `UNITY_EDITOR`), so the
  class is never compiled and **Tools → Map Builder** doesn't exist; its `using UnityEditor;` sits
  outside the guard in a runtime assembly.
- `Assets/Tools/FolderTool/HierarchyFolder.cs` also has an unguarded `using UnityEditor;` in the
  runtime assembly. Both will break player builds (CS0246) — TODO: confirm with a build.

## Resources / Addressables
- No Addressables. `Assets/Resources/` is loaded via `Resources.Load`: `GlitchPalette.asset`,
  `LaserData.asset`, `Pause_Menu.prefab`, plus node/corruption materials and textures. Third-party
  `Resources/` folders under `TextMesh Pro/` also ship.

## Import settings
- Asset serialization: **Force Text**; version control: **Visible Meta Files**.
- TODO: no import presets or `AssetPostprocessor` found — texture/model/audio conventions undocumented.

## Build
- Batchmode method `Project.Build.Editor.BuildCommand.Build` (`/build <platform>`): builds the enabled
  scenes from `EditorBuildSettings`, args parsed by `BuildArguments` (`-buildOutput`, `-development`,
  `-buildAab`; Win, macOS, Linux, Android output names).
- Build Profiles in `Assets/Settings/Build Profiles/`: `Windows.asset`, `Web.asset`.
- URP quality tiers: `Very Low` … `Very High` pipeline assets in `Assets/Settings/`.
- CI: none.

## Target platforms
- Windows (Standalone) — primary; Web (Build Profile exists). TODO: confirm which ones ship.
- Scripting defines (all platforms): `UNITY_POST_PROCESSING_STACK_V2;DOTWEEN` — neither package is
  in the project; TODO: confirm both are leftovers.
- No platform-specific code (`#if UNITY_ANDROID` etc.) in gameplay scripts.
